counting_levels.LEVEL_0_REGISTERED: Named candidate with a source lead; does not count toward the >=20 population gate.
counting_levels.LEVEL_1_TRUTH_SOURCE_BOUND: Independent authoritative identity/truth source exact enough to freeze truth; still does not count.
counting_levels.LEVEL_2_DISCOVERY_DATA_BOUND: Usable sonar/bathymetry discovery corpus independently bound and separable from truth; still does not count.
counting_levels.LEVEL_3_BLIND_EVALUATED: Candidate generation frozen before truth unlock and scored under the preregistered rule. Only this level counts toward n>=20.
